forbidden.note: Any step in the delivered rate at the materiality boundary is a failure. So is a zero rate at 10.8 beside a held 10.9. So is inferring zero biological consumption from either branch, and so is sizing a maintenance change from the negative arithmetic.

fixtures.title: Same-method repeats inside the 30-minute window are one resolved testing episode

provenance.note: Owner decision 17. Every reading is within 30 minutes of every other AND of the first, so the fixture does not depend on how Part II §5.3's window is anchored - that anchoring is a pre-existing wording question and is deliberately not exercised here.

expectedAction.note: Three repeats are one testing episode and one independent observation. ALK-MINIMUM-CADENCE-001 still needs three independent episodes over four days, so this is INSUFFICIENT - repeated testing cannot buy evidence count.

forbidden.note: Counting the three repeats as three independent observations, or emitting the mean 8.66 by averaging rather than the median of the pooled raw readings, or splitting them into three episodes because their timestamps differ.

fixtures.title: Incompatible methods inside one episode are contested, never averaged and never ordered

provenance.note: Owner decisions 17 and 18. The pair disagrees by 0.19 dKH, which is BELOW ALK-005's 0.20 - the episode is contested anyway, because 0.20 is a same-method repeat threshold and does not apply across incompatible methods. The three-minute case is the one F5-14's exact-timestamp rule could not reach.

expectedIntermediateEvidence.note: All three cases produce byte-identical output. The 0.19 dKH disagreement is never compared against 0.20.

openIssues: OI-CLUSTERTIE-001 - superseded for membership by owner decision 17

forbidden.note: Averaging or pooling the two into 11.045, selecting either by event, ID, insertion, database or sort order, applying ALK-005's 0.20 dKH to the 0.19 cross-method disagreement and calling the episode OK, or treating the three-minute case as two independent episodes. THREE_MINUTE_OFFSET must not differ from SAME_INSTANT in any output field.

fixtures.title: Position reads the resolved episode; a contested latest episode withholds it

provenance.note: Owner decision 19. The contested pair straddles OuterMax = 11.0: 10.95 is within bounds and 11.14 is breached. Under F5-14 the answer depended on which row the store returned first.

CONTESTED_LATEST.note: No worst-case-member rule exists and none is created: the classification is withheld and an immediate repeat requested. The exposure is recorded in ALK-EPISODE-SINGLE-OUTPUT-001.

forbidden.note: WITHIN_BOUNDS from 10.95 or BREACHED_HIGH from 11.14 - either chosen by ordering - is the defect this fixture exists to catch. Silently using yesterday's 10.60 is equally forbidden.

fixtures.title: Rapid detection consumes resolved episodes only

provenance.note: Owner decision 19, on AD-RAP-001's candidate-cluster series. Case A is unchanged behaviour: a resolved episode not accepted for ordinary trend still contributes to rapid. Case B contests the latest episode.

RESOLVED_NOT_ACCEPTED.note: ALK-008's grant is unchanged: an episode too close for ordinary trend still contributes to rapid.

CONTESTED_LATEST.note: The latest episode is a member of the pair by definition. It emits no value, so the determination is withheld - it is not computed from the older resolved pair as though the latest episode did not exist.

forbidden.note: Taking 7.95 (rapid, -0.325), taking 8.30 (not rapid, -0.15), or falling back to the older resolved pair 8.6 -> 8.5 over 1.5 days (-0.0666...) are all forbidden. One contested episode may not flip rapidConfirmed in either direction.

fixtures.title: The 0.20 dKH repeat threshold is exact-decimal and same-method only

provenance.note: Owner decision 18. Under binary64 the differences 8.80-8.60, 7.30-7.50 and 9.30-9.10 all evaluate strictly greater than 0.20 (0.20000000000000107, 0.20000000000000018, 0.20000000000000107) and would classify ANOMALOUS. Exact decimal comparison gives 0.20 > 0.20 = false. 10.75-10.55 evaluates to 0.1999999999999993 and agrees either way - it is included so the fixture is not only about pairs that straddle.

CROSS_METHOD.note: 0.19 is below 0.20, and that is irrelevant: the threshold is not applied across incompatible methods at all.

forbidden.note: Deciding any exact-0.20 case by binary64, introducing an epsilon to hide the problem, pre-rounding the readings to compare them, or reporting the cross-method pair as an OK cluster because 0.19 < 0.20.
